Application Data.NAME: Secure Storage Solutions, Inc.
Application Data.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Smith, Facility Manager, Secure Storage Solutions, Inc.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Secure Storage Solutions, Inc. operates a state-of-the-art self storage facility that prioritizes security and safety for our customers' belongings. Our facility features secure access gates with keycard entry, 24-hour video surveillance, and a monitored alarm system to ensure the protection of stored items. The property is well-maintained with regular inspections to prevent structural issues, water intrusion, or pest infestations. Additionally, we do not permit the storage of hazardous materials and have thorough risk controls in place to minimize potential loss from fire. Our commitment to risk mitigation and customer safety is reflected in our well-documented operational procedures and adherence to industry standards.

Key Risk Considerations
Underwriters should carefully evaluate the following exposures in-
herent to self storage operations:
• Fire Risk: Storage facilities often contain a variety of combustible materials, increasing
the likelihood and potential severity of fire losses. Evaluate the presence and condition of fire
detection and suppression systems, building construction type, and proximity to fire hydrants.
